en_title: PS5 Hits 100 Million Units Sold Mark 6 Years After Launch — Here's How It Compares to Other PlayStation Consoles
cn_title: PS5发售6年后销量突破1亿台——与其他PlayStation主机相比表现如何
opus_summary: 索尼宣布PS5全球累计出货量达到1亿台，较9月底公布的数据增加210万台。PS5已超过PS3的8740万台，但仍落后于PS4的1.17亿台。索尼此前上调PlayStation全年预期，同时取消了Haven的《Fairgames》。

paragraphs.en: PlayStation 5 has shipped 100 million units, Sony has announced . The milestone comes ahead of the launch of GTA 6, which is expected to boost console sales significantly. It means PS5 has shipped an additional 2.1 million units in the 40 days since it last reported PS5 sales, at the end of September.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼宣布，PS5的出货量已达到1亿台。这一里程碑是在《GTA6》发售之前达成的，预计该游戏将显著推动主机销量。这意味着，自索尼上次于9月底公布PS5销量以来的40天里，PS5又出货了210万台。

paragraphs.en: Sony Interactive Entertainment describes shipped units as “Cumulative Worldwide Hardware Unit Sales (Sell-in),” which isn’t sell-through to customers, but does give us an idea of how well the PS5 has sold.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼互动娱乐将出货量称为「全球硬件累计销量（渠道销售量）」，这并非实际售予消费者的数量，但确实能让我们了解PS5的销售表现。

paragraphs.en: PS5 hits 100 million six years after launch. The console released on November 12, 2020, in select countries and November 19, 2020, worldwide, amid the COVID pandemic and lockdowns. Console rival Microsoft launched the Xbox Series X and S at the same time, and does not report sales figures.
paragraphs.cn: PS5在发售6年后达到1亿台。这款主机于2020年11月12日在部分国家发售，并于2020年11月19日在全球发售，当时正值新冠疫情和封锁期间。主机竞争对手微软同期推出了XBOX Series X和S，但并未公布销售数据。

paragraphs.en: How does PS5 compare to other PlayStation consoles? It’s heading towards PS4’s 117 million total (as of June 30, 2022 — the latest data we have from Sony). It had already outsold the PS3’s 87.4 million total (as of March 31, 2017), and the PlayStation Portable’s 76.4 million as of March 31, 2012. It will soon overtake the original PlayStation’s 102.4 million, but is unlikely to surpass the PS2’s huge 160 million sales. Indeed, PS2 remains the best-selling console of all time, just ahead of the Nintendo Switch’s 157.2 million (as of September 30, 2026). Sony failed to disclose sales data for the PlayStation Vita, but it’s safe to say it wouldn’t have appeared high up on this list.
paragraphs.cn: PS5与其他PlayStation主机相比表现如何？它正朝着PS4的1.17亿台总销量迈进（截至2022年6月30日——这是我们掌握的索尼最新数据）。它已经超过了PS3的8740万台总销量（截至2017年3月31日），以及PlayStation Portable截至2012年3月31日的7640万台销量。它很快将超过初代PlayStation的1.024亿台，但不太可能超越PS2高达1.6亿台的销量。事实上，PS2仍是有史以来销量最高的主机，略高于任天堂Switch的1.572亿台（截至2026年9月30日）。索尼没有披露PlayStation Vita的销售数据，但可以肯定地说，它在这份榜单上的排名不会太高。

paragraphs.en: Perhaps the more important question for Sony is how PS5 is selling launch-aligned versus the PS4. As it stands, the PS5 is around 5 million behind its predecessor, but it’s worth remembering that the market is in a very different place for PS5 at this point in its lifecycle than PS4 was. The main drag on PS5 — and indeed all console sales — is price rises due to the AI-fueled ‘RAMpocalypse.’ Traditionally, video game consoles get cheaper the older they get, which in turn boosts second half lifecycle sales. This generation has seen the opposite happen, with consoles getting more expensive and sales dropping off.
paragraphs.cn: 对索尼来说，也许更重要的问题是，按发售时间对齐后，PS5的销量与PS4相比如何。目前，PS5落后其前代产品约500万台，但值得记住的是，PS5在生命周期的这个阶段所处的市场环境与PS4当时截然不同。拖累PS5销量——实际上也是所有主机销量——的主要因素，是由人工智能推动的「内存末日」导致的价格上涨。传统上，游戏主机上市时间越长，价格就越便宜，进而推动生命周期后半段的销量。但这一代主机的情况恰恰相反：主机越来越贵，销量也在下滑。

paragraphs.en: Still, Sony will be happy with how its gaming business is doing. Earlier this month, Sony raised its full-year forecast for PlayStation after higher net sales and operating income in the second quarter. And it has GTA 6 coming out next week.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管如此，索尼会对其游戏业务的表现感到满意。本月早些时候，在第二季度净销售额和营业利润增长后，索尼上调了PlayStation的全年业绩预期。而且《GTA6》将于下周发售。

paragraphs.en: It’s not all good news for PlayStation, however. With 2.4 million units sold, Marvel’s Wolverine is considered a disappointment . And just this week Sony continued its costly retreat from live service by canceling Haven’s Fairgames .
paragraphs.cn: 不过，对PlayStation来说也不全是好消息。销量为240万份的《Marvel’s金刚狼》被认为令人失望。就在本周，索尼取消了Haven的《Fairgames》，继续代价高昂地退出实时服务游戏领域。

paragraphs.en: Thoughts naturally turn to the next-gen and the promise of PS6 and possibly even a PlayStation handheld . Reports indicate next-gen consoles could cost more than $1,000 at launch, so it’s hard to image what follows PS5 getting anywhere near the 100 million sold mark.
paragraphs.cn: 人们自然会想到下一代主机，以及有望推出的PS6，甚至可能推出的PlayStation掌机。有报道称，下一代主机发售时的价格可能超过1000美元，因此很难想象PS5的继任者能接近1亿台的销量大关。
